cases.expected: ExecutionContext is returned whose ExecutionConfig.locale equals the locale from the SchemaValidatorsConfig, ExecutionConfig.formatAssertionsEnabled equals the flag from the config, and no customizer is invoked (i.e., the ExecutionContext remains unmodified).
cases.description: When the ValidationContext's config does not provide an ExecutionContextCustomizer (null), the method should create a fresh ExecutionContext populated with the config's locale and format‑assertions flag and return it without any further modification.

cases.expected: ExecutionContext is returned with the same locale and formatAssertionsEnabled values as in the config, and additionally the provided ExecutionContextCustomizer has been invoked – e.g., it sets a custom flag or property on the ExecutionContext that can be asserted after the call.
cases.description: When the ValidationContext's config supplies a non‑null ExecutionContextCustomizer, the method must invoke the customizer's `customize` method passing the newly created ExecutionContext and the ValidationContext. The test verifies that the customizer was called and that its side‑effects are reflected in the returned ExecutionContext.

cases.expected: ExecutionContext is returned whose ExecutionConfig.locale equals Locale.GERMAN and ExecutionConfig.formatAssertionsEnabled equals false (as provided by the SchemaValidatorsConfig). No customizer is invoked, so the ExecutionContext remains otherwise untouched.
cases.description: Validate that when the ValidationContext's config specifies a non‑default locale (German) and disables format assertions, the created ExecutionContext correctly reflects those values and no customization occurs.

cases.expected: ExecutionContext is returned whose CollectorContext.unevaluatedItemsAnalysisDisabled and CollectorContext.unevaluatedPropertiesAnalysisDisabled are both true, matching the flags set in SchemaValidatorsConfig. ExecutionConfig values are default (locale null, formatAssertionsEnabled false) because they were not overridden.
cases.description: Ensure that the CollectorContext constructed inside createExecutionContext copies the unevaluated‑items and unevaluated‑properties analysis disable flags from the configuration.

cases.expected: ExecutionContext is returned where the ExecutionConfig.locale has been changed to Locale.FRENCH by the ExecutionContextCustomizer. The customizer receives the newly created ExecutionContext and the original ValidationContext.
cases.description: Test that a non‑null ExecutionContextCustomizer is invoked and can mutate the ExecutionContext (e.g., overriding the locale). The test asserts that the locale after customization matches the value set by the customizer.

cases.expected: RuntimeException is thrown and propagates out of createExecutionContext, because the provided ExecutionContextCustomizer throws an exception during customization.
cases.description: Verify that createExecutionContext does not swallow exceptions from the customizer; any RuntimeException thrown by the customizer should be propagated to the caller.

When the JsonSchema instance's internal validationContext field is null, calling createExecutionContext() should throw a NullPointerException because the method attempts to invoke validationContext.getConfig().

When validationContext.getConfig() returns null, createExecutionContext() should throw a NullPointerException while trying to access methods on the returned config (e.g., config.isUnevaluatedItemsAnalysisDisabled()).
